offering_description.value: Kingstone sells homeowners and related personal property insurance, primarily to New York households and residential property owners. Its insurance subsidiary underwrites the policies, distributes them through independent agents and brokers, and handles claims.

primary_products.value: Homeowners insurance; dwelling fire insurance; condominium and co-op insurance; renters insurance

customer_segment.value: B2C: Homeowners, condominium and co-op owners, renters, and individual residential landlords

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: Policy premiums for residential property and personal liability coverage

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Pools policyholder premiums and underwrites residential property and liability risks for households and property owners

geography_served.value: US regional: Primarily New York, especially downstate New York

specialization.value: related lines: Homeowners, dwelling fire, condominium and co-op, and renters coverage

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: Independent retail and wholesale insurance agents and brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance licensing and oversight of solvency, rates, and policy forms, chiefly by the New York Department of Financial Services

notes: Current policywriting outside New York is uncertain.
